- When sentiment is positive (≥0.25), model tends to overestimate prices; adjust forecast downward by 0.5–1.5% for the next 3–5 days.
- After a sharp price spike (≥2% from prior day), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +1.5% above peak for next 3 days.
- Model consistently underestimates mean-reversion zones; add 0.3–0.8% upward bias in 10–15 day horizon if recent 5-day average is below 30-day moving average.
- If sentiment is flat (0.00) and price is trending downward, model underreacts; add 0.5–1.0% upward bias to prevent premature bottoming.
- For 30-day horizon, model often misses late-cycle corrections; apply 0.5–1.0% downward bias in final 5–7 days if sentiment is neutral or negative.
